scope:
Prepare bounded old/new additive-mix H1 EXEC source, without opening USB.

Source functions are extracted exactly from the frozen old and current renderer.
The compile base is offline sizing only; h1_debug exec run must rebuild using
the fresh resident allocation. No complete BDA, file, display or audio is run.
execution: Use fresh h1_debug exec run module.c --directory <new-dir> --opcode 0 or1 --budget-ticks 160. Optional args little-endian iteration count1..2097152, default1048576. Opcode0 old then new;1 reverses order. API raw tick is not asserted80Hz. Each bounded batch polls; poll time is included, and historical16384 batches hid compute differences behind one-tick yields. New default262144 keeps4polls per1M case. Each case stops after24raw ticks if count unfinished. flags1 canceled/flags2 duration cap. Only matched counts/CRC and zero flags support same-work timing comparison. Microbenchmark excludes complete game/render/display/audio and is not FPS. No dynamic allocations or persistent device resources. Module source and table are replaced only by root after checking the current EXEC state.
